多訓練肌力的話，提重物時也不會輕易就覺得累。這次「5-Minute Workout」繼續有兒童體適能教練Angel姐姐指導大家，並利用一條橡筋帶做運動。做好熱身，便可開始做五個肌力訓練動作，鍛練時記得注意吸氣和呼氣，而橡筋帶的長短可視乎能力而調整。小朋友長期姿勢不良，或會出現背部彎曲的情況，齊來做一個「超人」動作，對強化背部大有幫助？
小丸子與姐姐參加社區舉辦的聖誕聯歡會，有機會與區內小孩聚首一堂，亦因此看到大人的種種窘態。小丸子在繪畫比賽獲獎，在全校集會上獲頒獎狀，卻在等候上台時人有三急，令她不知如何是好。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
無處不在的空氣，是一種由氮氣、氧氣和其他氣體混合而成的氣體，它看不見，摸不着，無色無味。怎樣才能看見空氣的存在？高偉雄及鄭家明老師分別以實驗證明空氣佔有空間與重量，與及空氣中含氧氣成份。既然空氣是一種真實存在的物質，當它壓在一個物件上，就會對該物件產生壓力，即是大氣壓力，但是為甚麼我們感覺不到呢？
胖虎被禁止在家中練習唱歌。小夫因一時多口，導致胖虎每天都來小夫的房間練習唱歌。見此，多啦Ａ夢和大雄想拯救小夫…大雄約了靜香一起做功課，但在前往靜香家途中被胖虎逮住，更被迫替他看守門戶及打掃…

日常生活中許多物品都要靠能量才能運作，而能量會以不同形式出現，如：光能、熱能、聲能、電能、動能、位能等等。人類利用熱能來煮食，還利用電能使電器和機械運作而改善生活。那麼，有甚麼東西可以產生能量呢？鄭婉雯老師以紙風車、水車模型及汽球火箭，解釋風力及水力發電的科學細節，與及能量互相轉換的現象。

星期日，爸爸被噪音導致無法好好休息。因此，大雄想找個寧靜的地方給爸爸渡過這一天。霸道的胖虎總是獨佔自己想要的東西。剛巧多啦A夢有法寶可令物品變成幾份，大雄於是想到用此法寶來應對胖虎的獨佔欲。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
香港有一個名為「格仔山」的地方，這集的「大世界 小知識」就考考大家相關問題。開始之前，Carmen姐姐還給予提示：格仔山與以前的啟德機場大有關係。第一條問題是關於格仔山的原名，有小朋友根據啟德機場的提示，從地理位置推斷是「九龍仔山」……格仔山的斜坡被畫上多個「格仔」，是甚麼顏色？又有何用途？
小丸子看到飲食節目介紹蟹後，要求家裡吃蟹但遭拒絕，小丸子把心一橫，決定用自己的壓歲錢買蟹。小丸子經常忘記行程，得知城崎有用記事簿的習慣後，決定有樣學樣，央求媽媽買記事簿給她。

日常生活中許多物品都要靠能量才能運作，而能量會以不同形式出現，如：光能、熱能、聲能、電能、動能、位能等等。人類利用熱能來煮食，還利用電能使電器和機械運作而改善生活。那麼，有甚麼東西可以產生能量呢？鄭婉雯老師以紙風車、水車模型及汽球火箭，解釋風力及水力發電的科學細節，與及能量互相轉換的現象。
星期日，爸爸被噪音導致無法好好休息。因此，大雄想找個寧靜的地方給爸爸渡過這一天。霸道的胖虎總是獨佔自己想要的東西。剛巧多啦A夢有法寶可令物品變成幾份，大雄於是想到用此法寶來應對胖虎的獨佔欲。
講述了來自音樂王國的公主愛美莉，在神奇的樂園島上，與六位性格迥異的公主一起快樂成長的故事。她們經歷了各種挑戰，用神奇的音樂力量克服重重難關，建立深厚的友誼。
香港有一個名為「格仔山」的地方，這集的「大世界 小知識」就考考大家相關問題。開始之前，Carmen姐姐還給予提示：格仔山與以前的啟德機場大有關係。第一條問題是關於格仔山的原名，有小朋友根據啟德機場的提示，從地理位置推斷是「九龍仔山」……格仔山的斜坡被畫上多個「格仔」，是甚麼顏色？又有何用途？

這集，主持姐姐和Choco分享德國一位圓號演奏家的勵志故事。雖然天生沒有雙臂，他卻自小已立志要練好圓號，最終更排除身邊人的勸阻，成功以腳代手吹奏圓號。「My Little Show」舞台，江心悠、岑家亮用圓號與鍵琴合奏輕快樂章。兩人在訪問中提到，會注意節奏和溝通，避免於合奏時出錯。此外，主持們還會帶來一項中學生智能創意比賽的資訊。

太陽每天散發著光和熱，令地球出現白日和黑晚。太陽似乎遙不可及，但又與我們的生活息息相關，今集節目中，太陽所隱藏的秘密即將揭曉！我們平時看到的太陽光到底是白色還是黃色？七色彩虹是如何產生的？為甚麼雨後容易見到彩虹？太陽風又是甚麼？對地球有怎樣的影響？臭氧層有何作用？出現臭氧洞對人類有甚麼危害？Master Joe和科學老師透過多個實驗，解開一連串關於太陽的奧秘！
胖虎家中的暖爐壞了。因為不甘心只有自己捱凍，於是叫了大雄和小夫出來陪他捱凍。大雄被媽媽拿來與別人的孩子比較，因此而不開心。之後，大雄突然想到找一個弟弟來，證明自己也能做一個好哥哥。

《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

銀河由無數排列密集的恆星組成，太陽系就位於銀河系中，太陽系有8大行星，這些行星除了圍繞太陽公轉，亦都各自以一定的傾斜角度繞軸轉動。它們各有甚麼特色？哪顆行星最大？哪顆最熱？木星上的大紅點又是甚麼？兩位AI帶大家尋求答案！當月球、地球和太陽運行至連成一條直線時，站在地球上的我們就能看到太陽被部份或者整個月球遮蓋，最後出現一段時間的黑暗，這種自然現象就是「日食」。但有些星體並不會出現日食，這是為甚麼？
多啦美難得買到一直想吃的頂級蜜瓜包，卻被多啦Ａ夢擅自吃了。兄妹二人因此吵架。天氣寒冷，大雄不想出外，只想睡覺，還責怪地球的日間時間太長。見此，多啦Ａ夢用法寶幫大雄塑造一個理想的星球。

「Kids’ Notes」繼續有兒童畫家帶來更多作品，除了使用平板電腦及顏料作畫外，原來用石頭、雞蛋殼、報紙等生活上接觸到的物品都可「拼砌」出畫作。藝術家母親還提到女兒曾「採集」家中的頭髮去為火柴人作品增添細節？小畫家也會展示如何運用科技，為實體的畫作注入動畫和音樂的元素。要完成動畫創作雖然要衝破不少困難，但只要多作嘗試，過程就會越來越簡易。眾多以蛇為主題的作品之中，哪條「蛇」最得這位小畫家喜愛？
麵包店開張拉彩球，小丸子看見很喜歡，也想嚐嚐拉彩球滋味，於是與爺爺一起買材料製作。小丸子遇到一位經常做運動的大姐姐，得知對方來自東京，更是一名摔角手，大姐姐教她做事需要有拚勁。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

銀河由無數排列密集的恆星組成，太陽系就位於銀河系中，太陽系有8大行星，這些行星除了圍繞太陽公轉，亦都各自以一定的傾斜角度繞軸轉動。它們各有甚麼特色？哪顆行星最大？哪顆最熱？木星上的大紅點又是甚麼？兩位AI帶大家尋求答案！當月球、地球和太陽運行至連成一條直線時，站在地球上的我們就能看到太陽被部份或者整個月球遮蓋，最後出現一段時間的黑暗，這種自然現象就是「日食」。但有些星體並不會出現日食，這是為甚麼？
多啦美難得買到一直想吃的頂級蜜瓜包，卻被多啦Ａ夢擅自吃了。兄妹二人因此吵架。天氣寒冷，大雄不想出外，只想睡覺，還責怪地球的日間時間太長。見此，多啦Ａ夢用法寶幫大雄塑造一個理想的星球。

epg.programme_title_en: Amazing Animals - Adventure Team from Undersea #2 [Can/Man]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

「Kids’ Notes」繼續有兒童畫家帶來更多作品，除了使用平板電腦及顏料作畫外，原來用石頭、雞蛋殼、報紙等生活上接觸到的物品都可「拼砌」出畫作。藝術家母親還提到女兒曾「採集」家中的頭髮去為火柴人作品增添細節？小畫家也會展示如何運用科技，為實體的畫作注入動畫和音樂的元素。要完成動畫創作雖然要衝破不少困難，但只要多作嘗試，過程就會越來越簡易。眾多以蛇為主題的作品之中，哪條「蛇」最得這位小畫家喜愛？

今集「芭蕾天地」環節，首先送上著名芭蕾舞劇《胡桃夾子》的精采片段，之後導師會帶領一班學員示範一段劇中的舞步。香港芭蕾舞團藝術總監John Meehan受訪，提及他對男舞蹈員的看法。而「芭蕾禮儀教室」會講解欣賞芭蕾舞劇的禮儀。另外，攝影藝術家尹子聰會教小朋友一些攝影技巧。在「向攝影出發」中，他會講解拍攝黑白照和彩色照的手法；還帶領小朋友到香港仔進行戶外攝影，讓他們運用所學的技巧，拍出屬於個人的作品。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
正式登台在即，但兩人依然練習不多，檸檬為此感到擔憂，更打扮成米露琪的樣子去找她。檸檬到米露琪家裡的蔬果店幫忙，後者用雜菜湯作出比喻，指練習太多只會令兩人過度磨合，埋沒各自各的個性。

節目組讓小朋友寫兩封信，一封是給或將誕生的弟妹，另一封是自己的遺書。眾人都抱着愉快心情迎接新生命，對離世之事傷感。百日宴和喪禮，是生與死的兩樁人生大事，在籌辦過程中卻有不少相似的地方；洪永城帶孩子們作進一步認識。有男生親自體驗躺棺木、遺體化妝，感受如何？及後他為參加百日宴變妝，妝容會有甚麼不同？再探索二者的場地佈置，小朋友對選擇棺木、陪葬品各有想法；也會嘗試為百日宴製作氣球橋，及為喪禮預備棺面花。
一男一女本地小朋友，分別與一位外籍小孩背對背坐下。大家只透過說話認識對方，對於這種交友模式，眾人感受如何？主持洪永城講出不同的地方，讓孩子們說出第一印象，原來不少小朋友都覺得日本人有禮貌。永城接着帶兩位港孩家訪俄羅斯小朋友，並一同享用俄式家常菜，吃後有甚麼感想？餐後，眾位小朋友換上俄國的節慶服飾，隨俄裔男士體驗當地傳統舞蹈。大家及後還會試玩俄國民間的孩童遊戲，這是一款拋擲木棒的競技，玩法怎樣？

生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
正式登台在即，但兩人依然練習不多，檸檬為此感到擔憂，更打扮成米露琪的樣子去找她。檸檬到米露琪家裡的蔬果店幫忙，後者用雜菜湯作出比喻，指練習太多只會令兩人過度磨合，埋沒各自各的個性。

節目組讓小朋友寫兩封信，一封是給或將誕生的弟妹，另一封是自己的遺書。眾人都抱着愉快心情迎接新生命，對離世之事傷感。百日宴和喪禮，是生與死的兩樁人生大事，在籌辦過程中卻有不少相似的地方；洪永城帶孩子們作進一步認識。有男生親自體驗躺棺木、遺體化妝，感受如何？及後他為參加百日宴變妝，妝容會有甚麼不同？再探索二者的場地佈置，小朋友對選擇棺木、陪葬品各有想法；也會嘗試為百日宴製作氣球橋，及為喪禮預備棺面花。

生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。

未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
蚌蚌公主出任廠長主持大局，「零食廠」這次上演三對三的比拼。在考驗聆聽能力與反應的「廠長話」遊戲，眾人都表現出色。為了增加難度，蚌蚌公主要求小兵們同時做出兩個動作，大家可會應付得來？「溶化之橋」關卡，眼見兩位隊友分別運送四個與三個雪糕球都輕鬆抵達終點，最後登場的曲奇女兵決意挑戰五個雪糕球，能否安全送達？
小丸子希望早一步享受春天，於是聽從中野的建議，去河津町看在冬天綻放的河津櫻。媽媽為大家買了新恤衫，但爸爸更愛熟悉的舊恤衫。爺爺在外不慎摔倒，但想到自己穿著殘舊內褲，堅決拒絕就醫。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
星星是白色的嗎？每顆恆星都有其壽命，太陽會不會也有「死亡」的一天？而宇宙黑洞又是甚麼？恆星的壽命取決於質量大小和核心的燃燒程度，由一百萬年到幾百億年不等。其質量越大，熱核反應就會進行得越激烈！當恆星到了晚年，星體就會逐漸膨脹，並且發出紅色的光，變成「紅巨星」。太陽也是一顆恆星，會不會也變成「紅巨星」？宇宙中的黑洞體積小，密度大，擁有巨大的吸引力，連速度最快的光都難以穿過，它到底是甚麼神秘天體？
叔叔送了一套圖鑑給大雄。媽媽要大雄寫道謝信給叔叔，但大雄卻無法寫出得體的信。大雄家中的暖爐壞了。多啦A夢使用「呼喚精靈手鈪」召喚出火的精靈來取暖。但火的精靈卻失控，想把周圍的物品燒掉。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。
蚌蚌公主出任廠長主持大局，「零食廠」這次上演三對三的比拼。在考驗聆聽能力與反應的「廠長話」遊戲，眾人都表現出色。為了增加難度，蚌蚌公主要求小兵們同時做出兩個動作，大家可會應付得來？「溶化之橋」關卡，眼見兩位隊友分別運送四個與三個雪糕球都輕鬆抵達終點，最後登場的曲奇女兵決意挑戰五個雪糕球，能否安全送達？
小丸子希望早一步享受春天，於是聽從中野的建議，去河津町看在冬天綻放的河津櫻。媽媽為大家買了新恤衫，但爸爸更愛熟悉的舊恤衫。爺爺在外不慎摔倒，但想到自己穿著殘舊內褲，堅決拒絕就醫。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
星星是白色的嗎？每顆恆星都有其壽命，太陽會不會也有「死亡」的一天？而宇宙黑洞又是甚麼？恆星的壽命取決於質量大小和核心的燃燒程度，由一百萬年到幾百億年不等。其質量越大，熱核反應就會進行得越激烈！當恆星到了晚年，星體就會逐漸膨脹，並且發出紅色的光，變成「紅巨星」。太陽也是一顆恆星，會不會也變成「紅巨星」？宇宙中的黑洞體積小，密度大，擁有巨大的吸引力，連速度最快的光都難以穿過，它到底是甚麼神秘天體？
叔叔送了一套圖鑑給大雄。媽媽要大雄寫道謝信給叔叔，但大雄卻無法寫出得體的信。大雄家中的暖爐壞了。多啦A夢使用「呼喚精靈手鈪」召喚出火的精靈來取暖。但火的精靈卻失控，想把周圍的物品燒掉。

epg.programme_title_en: Couple and the Magic Lamp, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
閏秀李杏妍遭惡霸岳禮全迫婚，其未婚夫馬子龍亦被加害，幸為寺院方丈所救。妍為保清白而跳海，大難不死的她扮作厲鬼於雨夜出沒，人心惶惶。龍聯同被全迫害的苦主一同報仇，時妍出現，嚇得全墮崖身亡，妍和龍喜重逢。
梅夢雲為避戰火，與戀人阿芳失散。雲父生意失敗，愛上雲的余晚萍以借貸為條件逼婚。雲重遇芳，雲父為使雲死心，求芳假裝已婚。新婚夜雲與萍爭執後離去，萍為報復使計逼芳嫁予其兄。婚期近，芳自殺幸被救，與雲續緣。
徐子超目睹女友羅鳳玲墮樓身亡後，遇上劉福善，並得知羅伯豪當年強搶善妻及其孿生長女玲。玲受豪操縱販毒，直至重遇家人後欲擺脫豪，卻慘遭殺害，而與超相戀的是玲妹鳳珠。超得悉真相後，使計把豪誘到家中繩之以法。
葉文俊與妹玉英、表妹美蘭及英師姐施妙娥成功捉拿密謀造反的八王爺，豈料途中他被人救走。八王爺召集人馬準備起兵，俊等人得悉後欲先發制人，惜俊身中毒針，幸得九指神丐相救。俊等人與神丐裡應外合，終捉拿王爺。
閏秀李杏妍遭惡霸岳禮全迫婚，其未婚夫馬子龍亦被加害，幸為寺院方丈所救。妍為保清白而跳海，大難不死的她扮作厲鬼於雨夜出沒，人心惶惶。龍聯同被全迫害的苦主一同報仇，時妍出現，嚇得全墮崖身亡，妍和龍喜重逢。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皇帝駕崩，西宮奪位，駙馬衛國忠請任展鵬與白騰蛟相助。林飛鳳、林飛鶯兩姐妹唆使刺殺忠，幸被鵬等人制止。國舅劉厚瑞追殺太子，鵬借助神燈救走他。厚欲屠殺全城嬰兒，蛟以親兒頂替太子，並與鵬、鳳合計終推翻西宮。
葉文俊與妹玉英、表妹美蘭及英師姐施妙娥成功捉拿密謀造反的八王爺，豈料途中他被人救走。八王爺召集人馬準備起兵，俊等人得悉後欲先發制人，惜俊身中毒針，幸得九指神丐相救。俊等人與神丐裡應外合，終捉拿王爺。
梅夢雲為避戰火，與戀人阿芳失散。雲父生意失敗，愛上雲的余晚萍以借貸為條件逼婚。雲重遇芳，雲父為使雲死心，求芳假裝已婚。新婚夜雲與萍爭執後離去，萍為報復使計逼芳嫁予其兄。婚期近，芳自殺幸被救，與雲續緣。
劉競莊下嫁楊正儀，小姑冰嬌常借故令莊難堪，莊曾揚言報復。豈料嬌被殺，儀竟指證莊為兇手，莊被收監。莊姐夫趙君任高中狀元並任巡按，他感莊案疑點重重，遂微服偵查，卻險遭毒手，任大難不死，多番偵查終成功緝兇。
謝小瓊險被後父謝裕姦污，更逼她嫁給范玉山。其後裕被殺，黃二姑的表現，令雷探長起疑，可是二姑離奇斃命。瓊約會凌雲，惹山妒忌，於是誣告雲與命案有關，幸被雷識破。瓊與雲訂婚當晚，山潛入謝家，用槍指嚇瓊與雲…
醫生范俊華與未婚妻馬梅芳素未謀面，華堅拒沒有感情的婚姻。芳隨表妹區美英往看病，認識了華及助手畢烈。范父及馬父召華、芳回鄉成親，二人不知對方是訂婚對象而逃走。兩家各找烈、英代替，烈、英發現後撮合華、芳。
江山家園被燒，幸得新房東孔媽照顧，並與其女孔靜儀相戀。儀介紹山到侯家工作，侯悅容看上山，苦苦痴纏。管家一直覬覦侯家家財，儀因妒嫉竟與管家合謀害容，幸儀懸崖勒馬。容明白山愛儀，毅然讓愛，山與儀共諧連理。
姚庭春與妻田氏覬覦家產，田氏遂毒殺春弟並嫁禍弟婦楊秀珍，珍向兄楊勉求助卻被出賣。珍突然作動，幸得宋世傑妻唐氏助產子，並知悉珍被誣告著傑幫珍寫狀紙。傑施計將包庇田氏的田能等官員玩弄股掌中，成功為珍洗冤。

越王勾踐戰敗被擄。越臣范蠡為復國，尋得西施圖以美人計迷惑吳王夫差，可是二人日久生情並誕下麟兒，但為復國施甘捨家人。吳相伍子胥勸吳王不果，自挖雙目而亡。踐回國，臥薪嚐膽並趁機攻打吳國，蠡與施亦功成身退。

夏雲驤創立的公司生意蒸蒸日上，背後原來大有文章。雲驤病危，長子夏仲覺陪伴在側，次子夏仲慧卻只顧玩樂。表妹江靜霞鍾情仲慧，常與仲覺規勸他，惜他不知悔改。雲驤逝世，仲覺病倒，仲慧竟著忠伯於其藥中下毒，欲獨吞家產。仲覺死後冤魂作崇，仲慧惶恐不安，決定與靜霞結婚。結婚當晚，仲慧誤將靜霞當作仲覺而槍殺她，仲覺的亡魂欲殺仲慧時，仲慧驚醒，原來只是一場噩夢。仲慧阻止仲覺服下毒藥，並痛改前非，兩兄弟合力打理生意。

epg.programme_title_en: Spirit Killer Go Begging for an Orphan
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦父病重，將家財分予雪郎、泰郎及首名孫兒。雪妻程麗霜懷胎數月，雪上京赴考。泰妻王月嬌為霸家產欲令霜滑胎，卻把霜害死，幸其兒子安然出生。霜化冤魂藏起兒子，並行乞養子。期間，霜受驚露出鬼態，嚇得人心惶惶…
胡劍勤與林安妮兩夫婦互換崗位，誰能應付自如可當一家之主。妮穿上迷你裙到鄰居張秋平工作的洋行上班；勤對家務一竅不通，平妻李美玉幫忙。鄭經理欲迷姦妮，平及時相救，勤、玉誤會二人有染。幸妮父施計終平息風波。
丁伶自幼賣身入金家當童養媳，飽受家姑虐打。泉對伶情深，屢勸伶離開金家。伶的大伯家寶偷取金母首飾，被母發現，寶錯手將母殺死。眾人糾纏期間，寶頭部受撞擊而死。伶丈夫家福甘願讓愛，伶、泉、小姑麗容一同離去。

天虹國主帥蓋天鴻向海棠國下戰書，海棠公主遂往芙蓉國欲游說聯盟抵抗，卻被鴻截獲，鴻一念之仁放走她。海棠國得援兵相助，鴻兵敗如山倒被擒。海棠公主不忍恩將仇報，求國王放過鴻。其後鴻更憑玉珮認回親妹芙蓉公主。
李文傑將與表妹丁蕙芬結婚，但傑不慎弄歪了嘴，傑父怕芬嫌棄傑，著傑姐文慧暫冒充傑。慧對芬冷淡，讓芬誤會。莊仲才因與女友慧失聯多時，喬裝女傭入李家查探，終真相大白，芬卻不滿摑傑，竟讓傑回復原貌，皆大歡喜。

epg.programme_title_tc: 女攝青鬼乞米養孤兒大結局
epg.programme_title_en: Spirit Killer Go Begging for an Orphan
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: （續上集）程麗霜向夫秦雪郎哭訴遇害經過，並著雪隱瞞小英身份。雪兄嫂王月嬌誕下兒子後，雪與英更為受辱。後嬌驚悉英的身世，欲毒害他，幸霜及時相救，並讓嬌重演害她慘死的經過。嬌臨終前向雪懺悔，霜終含笑離去。

梅海玲和宋大明訂下白頭之約，可惜此時玲弟急病入院，明為助玲籌錢，不惜借貴利，但無力償還。玲得悉後，為替明還債無奈答應下嫁老翁古壽南，卻讓明誤會玲貪慕虛榮。南於新婚夜，得悉玲委身下嫁，遂贈金錢讓她與明結婚，可惜明已離去。轉眼二十年，明出人頭地回來，玲巧合地到明家當女傭，二人重逢，明出言侮辱玲，更趕她離開。玲傷心不已，適時重回故地的明友蘇炳文見狀，向明說出真相。明即找玲認錯，這對白頭情侶終可再續前緣。
呂淑莊與金源、盧連、盧筱雯偶然得到兩條鎖匙及一張地圖，而這些東西乃歹徒陶力與金源的叔父爭奪的目標，眾人因此捲進危機之中。淑莊被陶力騙至鬼屋後，誤以為金源叔父遭殺害。陶力威脅金源等人交出鎖匙並囚禁他們。金源等人逃脫卻發現其叔父未死，原來他與金源的父親、陶力皆為大賊，因盜取鑽石後發生內鬨，金父意外死去。最後陶力奪去鑽石，金源等人追至其巢穴，與他展開惡鬥。危急之際，警方及時趕至，淑莊等人平安無恙。
李文傑將與表妹丁蕙芬結婚，但傑不慎弄歪了嘴，傑父怕芬嫌棄傑，著傑姐文慧暫冒充傑。慧對芬冷淡，讓芬誤會。莊仲才因與女友慧失聯多時，喬裝女傭入李家查探，終真相大白，芬卻不滿摑傑，竟讓傑回復原貌，皆大歡喜。

天虹國主帥蓋天鴻向海棠國下戰書，海棠公主遂往芙蓉國欲游說聯盟抵抗，卻被鴻截獲，鴻一念之仁放走她。海棠國得援兵相助，鴻兵敗如山倒被擒。海棠公主不忍恩將仇報，求國王放過鴻。其後鴻更憑玉珮認回親妹芙蓉公主。
呂淑莊與金源、盧連、盧筱雯偶然得到兩條鎖匙及一張地圖，而這些東西乃歹徒陶力與金源的叔父爭奪的目標，眾人因此捲進危機之中。淑莊被陶力騙至鬼屋後，誤以為金源叔父遭殺害。陶力威脅金源等人交出鎖匙並囚禁他們。金源等人逃脫卻發現其叔父未死，原來他與金源的父親、陶力皆為大賊，因盜取鑽石後發生內鬨，金父意外死去。最後陶力奪去鑽石，金源等人追至其巢穴，與他展開惡鬥。危急之際，警方及時趕至，淑莊等人平安無恙。

梅海玲和宋大明訂下白頭之約，可惜此時玲弟急病入院，明為助玲籌錢，不惜借貴利，但無力償還。玲得悉後，為替明還債無奈答應下嫁老翁古壽南，卻讓明誤會玲貪慕虛榮。南於新婚夜，得悉玲委身下嫁，遂贈金錢讓她與明結婚，可惜明已離去。轉眼二十年，明出人頭地回來，玲巧合地到明家當女傭，二人重逢，明出言侮辱玲，更趕她離開。玲傷心不已，適時重回故地的明友蘇炳文見狀，向明說出真相。明即找玲認錯，這對白頭情侶終可再續前緣。

epg.programme_title_en: What's Between a Man & a Ghost
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫銀花與呂天和相戀，但花被迫嫁給孫若崇為妾，後被崇妻陳氏誣衊與和有姦情。花誕下紹宗後，被推下山崖，幸大難不死，化身為攝青鬼報仇。多年後，和終與花重逢，時宗為捕攝青鬼而向花開槍，因而揭發前事，真相大白。
李克勝與白玉梅本指腹為婚，但兩人都擔心對方貌醜，勝找欠債的金福代為拜堂，梅亦找婢女梅月白代嫁。福、白本是未婚夫妻，兩人均誤會對方負情而與別人成親，幸最終誤會解開，福與白成為眷屬，勝與梅亦結成佳偶。
（續上集）杜諾遭暗算掉下懸崖，幸大難不死，更遇上高人，獲傳授武功。原來暗算杜諾的蒙面人正是邵振文，他竟是杜諾殺父仇人五雷神君的徒弟，兩人狼狽為奸。杜諾得小冥女等人之助，最終成功手刃神君師徒，大仇得報。
陸青雲與戀人白秋兒連番遭奸人周沖加害，兒不幸被殺，雲逃離。實屬帝裔之後的兒，獲萬事聖母相救，並給予天書解困。兒跟從聖母指示化成生母的人頭，向皇帝告御狀。沖終被斬首，兒獲封公主，並與已成狀元的雲成眷屬。

蔡伯龍的鏢局押送鏢銀遭女賊截劫，並留下飛刀，讓龍回想因誤信沖天炮而趕走其妻陳韻霜。女賊蔡無雙提出與龍比武，惜不敵，霜便告知龍雙乃其親女，龍求霜原諒遭拒，時炮找雙報仇，龍出手相助，霜感動，一家破鏡重圓。
作家黃志民自與妻子李芳離婚後，與女兒小玉相依為命。當年原來何彪使計讓芳誤會民移情別戀，再騙芳嫁給他以得其金錢做非法勾當。其後彪更綁架玉向芳索錢，民得知後與芳爭執，民錯手開槍。玉以為芳被殺，替父認罪……

天朝尚書周公智密謀造反，向皇帝下蠱毒。陳秋荷為救皇帝，往取天蛇膽作藥引，卻中蛇毒，幸獲金蛇公主相救。烏蘭國興兵侵犯，荷出征抗敵，與金蛇公主交鋒。為平息干戈，智被斬首，兩國修好，荷與金蛇公主亦締結良緣。

孫悟空打敗六耳獼猴，六耳獼猴懷恨，伺機報仇。悟空因偷吃王母的蟠桃及搗亂天宮，被佛祖壓於五指山下，多年後才獲唐僧所救，隨他往取西經。期間，六耳獼猴假冒悟空，令八仙與悟空交惡，幸而最終辨出真偽，真相大白。

epg.programme_title_en: Fate of My Poor Daughter-in-Law, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葉振雄走私被捕入獄，雄妻因操勞致失明。十年後，雄子仲華娶青梅竹馬的張玉梅為妻，時戰亂旱災，幸梅拾得金銀珠寶，一家生活轉好。此時雄潦倒歸來，華不認父，還納梅的表姐丁月芳為妾。梅屢遭芳欺凌，決投河自盡……
阿昌得夢娜相助解困，並與眾房客為娜任職的歌廳裝修，但眾人將歌廳佈置與靈堂相若而被辭退。昌當上殯儀經紀，卻把歌廳老闆的屍體弄失，原來老闆未死，被包租的英妹救了。老闆將歌廳交予英打理，並讓眾人於歌廳工作。
術士領著一群行屍進城，宋丹萍混於其中，要找軍閥閻將軍報仇，機緣巧合下救了革命志士黃強。原來昔日萍與歌妓花鳳仙相戀，閻因迷戀仙而謀害萍，萍容顏被毁，仙則自殺。萍與革命志士合作，潛入閰府，與閰同歸於盡。
明末亂世，華雲表得獨臂神尼相助，救回被金吊兒擄走的文鳳子，又知悉八八道士率領的十五門派與滿人勾結。表、鳳等在他們起事之日，將十五門派瓦解。時清兵入關，尼感凋零國事難挽，著表等暫隱居，靜待時機滅清復明。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群漠視勸誡的年青人貿然闖進詭異森林露營作樂,入夜之後,他們內心的邪念驅使他們落入性與愛的關係陷阱,引來了森林裡一連串的靈異事件。黎明將至,他們當中有誰能逃生?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them.  When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為逃離家暴陰影,Jennifer搬進212號公寓展開新生活,卻每天醒來身上出現詭異且疼痛的咬痕。她驚覺牆內潛藏著以活人血肉為食的古老寄生怪物。隨著襲擊加劇,面對這場嗜肉噩夢,她必須在被徹底蠶食之前,鼓..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 思南和丈夫前往吉隆玻度假,希望能緩解懷孕帶來的壓力。然而,她意外發現丈夫有個陰險的計畫,要將他們的孩子變成「碌葛」以謀取利潤,使她陷入危險之中。思南幸得酒店鬼魂的幫助,成功逃脫並報警將丈夫拘捕,最終安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Nan and her husband travel to Kuala Lumpur for a vacation to relieve her pregnancy stress. However, she soon uncovers his evil plan to turn their child into a Luk Krok for profit, which puts her in grave danger. With the help of the hotel ghosts, she manages to flee and alert the police to arrest him, finally giving birth to her child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world descends into darkness when a sealed book, said to command the forces of the universe, is unearthed in an underground palace in the desert. As adventurers race to claim its power, the palace gates open, unleashing an unseen terror and heralding a catastrophe beyond imagination.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靜雯是一名努力奮鬥的戲劇學生,為了應付學費開支而接受了一份模特兒的工作。然而,當她為一位專門從事表現性人體素描的神秘藝術家擔任模特兒時,靜雯意外地揭露了一個驚人真相,更將她推向生死邊緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jing Wen, a struggling drama student, takes on a modelling job to help cover her tuition costs. As she becomes a model for an enigmatic artist specializing in expressive human body sketches, Jing Wen accidentally uncovers a shocking truth, plunging her into a desperate fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy gets bitten by a rabid bat during her last graveyard shift as a veteran punk rock disc jockey. When a storm traps Amy, her mysterious replacement and an anxious staff inside their small-town radio station, reality starts to distort as they go deeper into the graveyard shift…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模餘虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈?  在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The barbababies are glued to the TV. Since they love it so much, their parents encourage them to make their own shows. // The Barbapapa visit the museum of evolution. On the program: creation of the E

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to ge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 林少游、石大勇及關飛,三者俱屬浪跡江湖之豪俠,表面上遊戲人間,實則滿懷壯志,誓以抗暴為己任。一次,機緣恰巧,林等三人助青年富戶楚鐵俠逃出險境,並結為生死之交。元朝異族王爺早有霸佔富戶財富的野心,後更借故追捕楚,林等遂出手相助,共谋抗暴大業...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu’s family fortune

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong’s hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.programme_title_en: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶,從此富貴。這時,周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子,却原來是個陷阱,為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後,可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 中州劍派掌門人江子超與女兒上青,一次路見不平,拔劍救婦,與血符門結怨;江氏大徒弟韓更是全家均被血符門凶徒所殺,結下深仇。後江氏父女不敵血符門凶徒,先後殞命,江氏門下七師妹芳芳,誓與韓合力消滅血符門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠女出生不久後,父母慘被四名悍匪所殺。長大後,她誓要為父母報仇雪恨。於是她苦練武功,並與劍客和一對夫婦合力將所有悍匪殺死。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女波波為尋父和找尋未婚夫羅烈,遇上童時玩伴黑豹,黑豹是城中勢力最大金二爺的助手。波波在黑豹照料下,逐漸忘記羅烈而愛上黑豹,黑豹自幼就喜歡波波,但是處處輸給羅烈,心狠手辣的他,逼婚不成,便在波波面前折磨金二爺,原來金二爺竟是波波的父親趙大爺,後來羅烈出獄…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某天,俠盜楚留香歡宴好友無花和尚,神水宮的宮南燕突然來到,指稱楚盜去神水宮的天一神水,且用以毒殺多人。在楚留香極力否認下,宮南燕表示他需於一個月內找出真凶,否則必將置其於死地。楚留香為證明自身清白,決意著手調查此事件...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某天,俠盜楚留香歡宴好友無花和尚,神水宮的宮南燕突然來到,指稱楚盜去神水宮的天一神水,且用以毒殺多人。在楚留香極力否認下,宮南燕表示他需於一個月內找出真凶,否則必將置其於死地。楚留香為證明自身清白,決意著手調查此事件...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白玉龍找尋失蹤的父親白震東,與丐幫幫主安樂天的義女魏金鳳日久生情,終於在金劍莊成婚。婚後不久,玉龍竟被「龍門宮」的人捉去。白父曾和其宮主龍仙子結婚,誕下玉龍,現龍七姑迫玉龍遵守宮規和月蘭結婚!玉龍逃回金劍莊,龍仙子至,母子相認,仙子召集門人,決意將宮規廢除!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by Dragon Gate Palace one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and  reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together,

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平時表現得不諳武術的酒鋪女子關寶珠,原來是武功了得且專門鋤強扶弱的黑蝴蝶。一次黑蝴蝶用從五魔山寨撂奪得來的金子濟貧,令她被黑白二道追捕。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雍正雄才大略,殘忍狠毒,特組「血滴子」特務集團,以作暗殺反清人士的工具。不料,馬騰不值雍正濫殺無辜,乃叛變潛逃出宮。雍正怕後患無窮,命御前侍衛剛振風及宣寶鷹,務必將馬緝拿到手。馬攜妻兒在昔日同僚追殺下,輾轉逃亡,匿於江南,開設打鐵館,並發明鐵傘以破血滴子...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沈昌生性沉鬱,與父親缺乏溝通,被人利用,誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘,竟然出賣父親,讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加,獨闖飛仔巢,逐一將之擊斃,自已也進入瘋狂狀態。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge

epg.programme_title_tc: 陸小鳳傳奇之綉花大盜
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一輛鏢車在押送途中遭一身穿紅棉袄、脚穿紅綉花鞋的綉花大盜劫走。戒備森嚴的平南王府寶庫也遭竊,王府總管的雙眼更被劫匪刺瞎。束手無策的總捕頭金九齡請陸小鳳出馬調查此案。陸小鳳可否憑綉花大盜在案發現場所留下之刺綉查明他真正身分?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the Embroidery Bandit starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清兵火燒少林寺後,少林弟子洪熙官身受重傷,負傷逃亡。途經此地的方世玉誤以為洪熙官是窮凶極惡之徒,遂將他交給清兵。當方世玉得知自己錯捉洪熙官後,便千方百計設法營救,好讓二人聯手對抗清兵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fa

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由著名文學家徐籲的小說《後門》改編,故事講述徐天鶴與太太結婚多年,膝下猶虛,對隔壁小女孩阿琳甚有好感。阿琳父母離婚,孤苦伶仃,徐太太提議收阿琳為繼女,琳父母喜不自勝。後來阿琳親母史小姐出現,要接回阿琳;徐太太不忍拆散母女骨肉,毅然將阿琳交回親母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu’s until her long lost mother appears

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述傅紅雪為了應付勢力龐大的陰謀家公子羽,除了力敵對方的爪牙,亦要智破對方的詭計。憑藉出色的武打設計、華麗的佈景、唯美的拍攝技巧及強勁的演員陣容,《天涯明月刀》在武俠電影的歷史上創下高鋒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去台北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comi

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個歌舞女郎張萍、葉鳳、林芝蘭,隨歌舞團去台北表演,歌舞團經紀陳彼德原與葉拍拖,但陳移情於胡聞鶯。張萍出發前被男友拋棄,葉鳳要從鶯手上追回陳彼德的愛,林芝蘭為卻一心不嫁富豪誓不回。引出烏龍百出的愛情喜劇……

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓戰結束之後的漢城,出現了近代四騎士。他們包括拳術教官金義、搏擊教練馮俠、爆破專家高英寒及槍械專家李維詩。四人於兵燹之中倖存,不約而同以尋歡作樂作為生活方式。以霍克、雷泰、銀花為首的販毒組織,欲收買退役美國軍曹偷運毒品回國,軍曹最後不欲冒險,被霍克手下爪牙殺死。馮俠被嫁禍成殺人嫌疑犯,金義、高英寒、
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 翰林院大學士劉墉機智多謀,口才了得,常難倒乾隆。乾隆心中不忿,欲設計刁難他,但劉墉人急智生,妙語如珠,反令乾隆又再語塞。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主角小雜種由隱士撫養並授以武術;一天,隱士囑他下山訪尋父母。途中,他體驗到人情冷暖,先與女乞丐小乙惺惺相惜,建立「同是天涯淪落人」的友 誼,亦與邑紳之子顧英豪結怨。最後,他終於從妓院鴇母口中得知自己的身世,原來其生母本在顧家為婢,被老爺引誘成姦後,又遭虐待致死…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祝英台女扮男裝入學堂求學,並與同窗梁山伯結下至死不渝的深情厚愛。山伯得知英台真實身份後,立即前往祝家提親,豈料英台早已被許配他人,二人被迫含淚分離。山伯因悲痛過度,一病不起,最終含恨離世。英台驚聞噩耗,悲痛欲絕,哭祭山伯墳前,更縱身躍入墓中,以身殉情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo di

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海盜張保仔洗劫一艘外國商船後,發現海盜船身出現裂痕。於是他上岸尋找材料修船,竟發現清朝貪官正在欺壓貧苦農民。本性善良的張保仔,決心要鋤強扶弱,最終更成為著名的大海盜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he d

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

《敖魯古雅的小俠客》故事梗概

    鄂溫克族10歲男孩烏熱,在一次捐書活動中意外得到一本舊日記,因為有著相同的喜好,他邀請遠在北京未曾謀面的李皓來敖魯古雅鄉野放小熊卡爾,李皓因與母親賭氣,瞞著媽媽隻身來到敖鄉,他與烏熱等幾個孩子在玩耍中..

上海海洋大學學霸型男孩林航(黃世超飾)一直暗戀著理科男心目中的女神張憶歌(鄭穎元飾)。
    林航是劉豐教授(謝君豪飾)的高徒,他隨劉教授研究大閘蟹養殖,並製作烹飪大閘蟹的節目。
    在海洋大學舉辦的海峽兩岸大閘蟹養殖培訓班上..
抗美援朝戰爭時期,美國李奇威將軍對我志願軍實施剿殺戰略,對我軍公路、鐵路運輸線展開狂轟亂炸。彭總司令委任梁軍英擔任交通運輸總司令。梁司令與廣大幹部戰士群策群力,以自己的血肉之軀扛起了我軍的生命線。
描寫一位紅軍出身的地下報務人員李俠在抗日和解放戰爭中,在上海出生入死與日本及國民黨特務巧妙周旋,英勇鬥爭,最後在上海解放前夕壯烈犧牲的英雄故事。

影片講述了抗擊英國向中國傾銷鴉片的故事.

    道光年間,由於英商向中國輸入鴉片,中國白銀大量外流。湖廣總督林則徐從民族大局考慮,上書道光皇帝,請求查禁鴉片。道光皇帝堅定禁煙決心,並命林則徐為欽差大臣,前往廣東。林則徐人還未到,便傳..
講述各路人馬因追索稀世珍寶“達摩劍引發恩怨情仇。
在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dominic Toretto 與他的團隊迎戰致命新敵——為復仇而來的 Deckard Shaw!在這場《玩命關頭》系列高燃篇章中,動作全面引爆,團隊為了守護彼此,不惜一切代價。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dominic Toretto and crew face a deadly new enemy—Deckard Shaw—seeking revenge in this high-octane chapter of the Fast  Furious saga. Action explodes as the team fights to protect their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這部火爆的《玩命關頭》外傳中,霍布斯與蕭聯手對抗擁有致命生化武器的超級反派!動作場面震撼升級,巨石強森、傑森·史塔森、伊卓瑞斯·艾爾巴領銜主演,火力全開,不容錯過!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hobbs and Shaw team up to stop a superhuman villain with a deadly bio-weapon in this explosive Fast  Furious spin-off starring Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham, Idris Elba, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影取材自二戰真實事件,講述了一支美國潛艦小隊奉命捕捉一艘載有恩尼格瑪密碼機的德國U型潛艇的故事。一場充滿緊張、欺騙與生存挑戰的水下動作驚悚之戰即將展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:自由幻夢 Ⅰ
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球轟動的系列持續延燒。凱妮絲(珍妮佛·勞倫斯 飾)在摧毀飢餓遊戲後倖存下來,並與第13區聯手,挺身對抗殘暴的史諾總統(唐納·蘇德蘭 飾)。革命的火焰已被點燃,帕納姆的命運正面臨最關鍵的一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide phenomenon continues. Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) has survived and destroyed the Hunger Games, and now rises with District 13 to fight against President Snow (Donald Sutherland).

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹是一名掙扎求生的牧場主,他自願押送被捕的盜賊首領班・韋德前往火車站,準備搭乘開往猶馬的 3:10列車接受審判。然而,班那群冷血無情的同夥卻早已盤算好其他計劃。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dan is a struggling rancher who volunteers to safely deliver Ben Wade, the captured leader of a gang of thieves, to a train station where the 3:10 to Yuma will transport him to trial. Ben’s gang of cutthroats and robbers has other plans.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Pitch Black*, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克里斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末。起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬——直到令人不安的真相浮出水面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her family’s estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship—until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事以動盪不安的當代芝加哥為背景,四個毫無共同點的女人,唯一的交集是她們已故丈夫因犯罪活動而留下的債務。她們決定掌握自己的命運,共同謀劃依據自己的方式開創未來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in contemporary Chicago, amidst a time of turmoil, four women with nothing in common except a debt left behind by their dead husbands criminal activities, take fate into their own hands, and conspire to forge a future on their own terms.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貪腐富豪殺害犯罪目擊者,唯一證人是一名與中國政府有關係的商人之女友。北京保鑣協助香港警方保護她,卻在過程中與證人產生情愫,令任務更加複雜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt tycoon kills witness to a crime. Only the girlfriend of a businessman with Chinese govt. ties saw it. Beijing bodyguard helps Hong Kong police protect her. But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果。這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一名黑人父親藉由殺死襲擊者來為遭到殘暴傷害的女兒報仇後,一位年輕律師必須在一個因種族緊張局勢和三K黨而陷入深度分裂的密西西比州小鎮上為他進行辯護。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a Black father avenges his daughters brutal assault by killing her attackers, a young lawyer must defend him in a small Mississippi town deeply divided by racial tension and the Ku Klux Klan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在充斥著貪腐、謀殺以及影星光環的繁華背後,三名警官誓死奮戰,只為揭開一起殘忍連環慘案背後的駭人真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 昆汀・塔倫提諾第八部作品,背景設定於寒冷的懷俄明州,八名陌生人——包括兩名賞金獵人與一名通緝犯——在暴風雪中被迫聚在一起,對抗天候,也彼此對立。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

epg.programme_title_en: Vampire Wars: Battle For The Universe
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2210年,一支奉命營救人類、抵禦吸血鬼襲擊的隊伍,卻發現吸血鬼正密謀全面接管世界,並且得到來自意想不到勢力的協助。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2210, a crew dispatched to rescue humans from a vampire attack discovers that the vampires are plotting a take-over…and getting help from a surprising source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《 醉後末日》中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰。導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷、幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanity’s future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名少林武者對抗販賣奴隸的惡勢力,誓要阻止同胞被賣往美洲金礦淪為苦役。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Shaolin warrior battles slave traders to stop his countrymen from being sold into bondage in the gold mines in America.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 爭取脫離英國統治、追求獨立的民眾,遭到軍隊鎮壓,引發一場血腥暴動,而政府隨後加以掩蓋。超過一百名馬爾他人被誣陷為暴力事件的煽動者,遭到不公正的監禁。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《星際傳奇》中,馮・迪索飾演危險罪犯雷迪克,與一群倖存者受困於荒漠星球。面對嗜血怪物與灼熱雙日,他們必須彼此信任,才能撐過致命黑夜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Pitch Black*, Vin Diesel stars as Riddick, a dangerous convict stranded on a desert planet with survivors. Facing carnivorous monsters and scorching suns, they must trust each other to survive the deadly night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dominic Toretto 與他的團隊迎戰致命新敵——為復仇而來的 Deckard Shaw!在這場《玩命關頭》系列高燃篇章中,動作全面引爆,團隊為了守護彼此,不惜一切代價。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dominic Toretto and crew face a deadly new enemy—Deckard Shaw—seeking revenge in this high-octane chapter of the Fast  Furious saga. Action explodes as the team fights to protect their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《超世紀戰警》中,馮·迪索回歸飾演雷迪克,此時的他是一名被流放到殘酷監獄的逃犯。在凱拉的陪伴下,他必須逃離這裡並擊敗死亡兵團,以拯救銀河系。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *The Chronicles of Riddick*, Vin Diesel returns as Riddick, now a fugitive exiled to a brutal prison. With Kyra by his side, he must escape and defeat the Necromongers to save the galaxy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩兄弟身為芝加哥消防員,面對致命縱火案時產生激烈衝突。《烈火悍將》結合震撼動作與懸疑謎團,由寇特·羅素、威廉·鮑德溫與勞勃·狄尼洛領銜主演,火勢升溫,一觸即發!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two firefighter brothers clash while battling deadly arsons in Chicago. With explosive action and a gripping mystery, Backdraft stars Kurt Russell, William Baldwin, and Robert De Niro.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫。當軍方無力介入、政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 城裡驚現“僵屍病毒,人心惶惶,民不聊生。茅山弟子雲淩與三位師兄弟奉命下山盡辦法解救百姓於水火,不料四人卻步入幕後黑手的陷阱,被幻蠱術迷惑,挑撥四人之間的兄弟情。及後城中更有一只壯如怪獸的食人鬼蛛入侵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a town ravaged by the vampire virus, four Maoshan disciples including Yun Ling are tasked with finding the cure. However, they are entrapped by the schemes of the mastermind, which caused discord amongst them. When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bai and Ling are expelled from Kunlun Sect after acquiring a mystical mirror and a forbidden martial arts skill. They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重案組臥底警員山哥向高級督察唯Sir發送線報,说大毒梟金先生將會親自主持一宗涉及金額達二千萬美元的毒品交易。其實這是個為了找出誰是臥底而設計的陷阱,山哥身份暴露後被黑幫追殺,而其臥底身份也突然被警方刪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1925, the peaceful Bei Hai City is terrorized by a giant crocodile that devours and kills villagers. A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.
