epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度,狡猾和敏捷?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在野外狩獵,躲避掠食者和交配不僅需要技能,還需要完美地適應身體各部分.在某些情況下,進化會把身體部位變成真正厲害的工具.在本集中,我們會遇到一些動物:擬態章魚,墨西哥鈍口螈,三種鳥類和指猴,牠們的身體部位使它們在生存戰中佔據優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解世上最大的火山島,一個孤獨而崎嶇不平的地方,蒸汽散逸,水花四濺,每天都有新土地誕生.且看冰火交融如何打造地球上最強大的地質島嶼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn about the worlds largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽從前由冰雕鑿而成,現在則是由火山建構的島嶼.大約150萬年前,一塊冰地從北而下並覆蓋了整片土地.時至今日,巨大的冰川仍繼續一邊雕刻著海洋懸崖,一邊砍伐山脈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進芬迪灣洶湧的水域.瞭解這個東岸生態系統如何維持眾多生物,當中包括成千上萬的海鳥,世上最快的捕食者,以及複雜的無脊椎動物網絡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the Bay of Fundys surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the worlds fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大不列顛島的西海岸,世上最長的無間斷步道穿越超過800英里的壯麗景色.威爾斯海岸的多樣化景觀簡直是地質瑰寶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the worlds longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟.它被大西洋,莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giants Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌.從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canadas only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南方的絨毛蛛猴朵拉邁出了離開媽媽咪咪的第一步,跟著牠一起領略巴西大西洋沿岸森林的魅力吧.學習蛛猴群的動作技巧,學習掛尾技術,並看看這個小傢伙在同齡人中找到自己的位置.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the enchantment of Brazils Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與勇敢的浣熊小貓蒂亞戈一起踏上冒險之旅.看看這個像浣熊一樣的小傢伙如何磨練自己的嗅覺與覓食技能,穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的巴西森林家園附近的郊區公路,同時躲避被汽車撞到的危險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西美麗的潘塔納爾濕地,參觀巨型水獺的最後一個棲息地.跟隨幼崽里奧和牠的兄弟姐妹,看他們如何試水,如何聯手躲避美洲虎的伏擊,並成為一個有凝聚力的家庭單位,共同狩獵並繁衍生息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazils beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器,枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體,以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集會看一些世上最大的昆蟲.蟬形齒指蝦蛄被獵食者威嚇時,會打開翅膀,展露代表警告的色彩和圖案.巨型非洲百足是溫和的草食性動物,但不代表能欺負牠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crawl along with some of the worlds fiercest insects. Watch as giant cockroaches build their immune systems to ensure long life. Then check out the toxic prowess of giant millipedes and the invisibility cloaks of giant prickly stick insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視野對生存尤關重要.這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法.眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vision – its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無間的生死大戰中,動物已經進化出各種各樣的顏色,圖案和形狀,幫助它們捕獵,隱藏和保護自己.我們在本集解釋了一些最有趣的偽裝和變色能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hiding in plain sight helps many insect, fish, and amphibian species survive. Learn the ins and outs of an array of animal invisibility techniques, such as warning and disruptive colouration, mimicry, and active camouflage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道,河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 角馬為群體階級而戰,狐獴過著幫派生活,鯖魚在陸上分勝負,蝗蟲在同類相食的瘋狂中放棄素食主義.這一切都發生在南非的野外和開闊的景致中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​前往一個度假村,斯圖和莉芙試圖在度假者面前捕捉一條懷孕的紅腹黑蛇.觀看米克和阿黛爾抓住一條正在追逐雞肉晚餐的花紋監視蜥蜴,然後與傑絲和丹一起捕捉一個滑溜的車庫入侵者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與斯圖和莉芙一起變得一團糟,他們試圖智勝一條大型藍舌蜥蜴.與傑絲和丹一起賽跑,試圖在一條懷孕的蛇變成多條之前救出它,並看看米克和阿黛爾如何將一條蟒蛇遠離兩隻玩耍的小狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 撒哈拉以南的緯度為繁多的戰士提供了多樣性的戰場.雄性長頸鹿像落錘一樣擺動頭部,斑馬擁有動物王國中最強大的踢腿,黑猩猩的戰爭異常地似曾相識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The latitudes south of the Sahara offer vastly different battlegrounds for a wide range of warriors. Male giraffes swing their heads like wrecking balls, zebras boast the most powerful kick in the animal kingdom, and chimpanzee warfare is eerily f...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​放鬆一下,觀看米克和阿黛爾在一個養老院中打斷一對交配的東部棕蛇.與斯圖和莉芙一起處理不需要的庫存,他們在倉庫中捕捉到一條綠樹蛇,然後與傑絲和丹一起悄悄接近一位兇險的訪客.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephants secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與自然界中最狡猾和堅韌的戰士一起部署生化武器.釋放科莫多龍的毒咬,與獴群一起抵抗有毒的敵人,並觀察鳥類如何使用骨骼粉碎的力量來反擊有毒攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野外的生死大戰既激烈又無情.獵食或飢餓造成的死亡總是近在咫尺.有些動物通過變大或變快來適應這種環境,但其他動物進化出更有趣的能力.針鼴是一種非常奇怪的小動物,怪在牠們的繁殖能力.鞭蠍,也許是世界上最鮮為人知的蜘蛛綱動物.當牠受到威脅時,可以向捕食者射出刺鼻的醋酸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keep your distance from these natural-born killers. Armed with venom and other poisonous tools that make hunting easier (and escape impossible), nudibranches, cuttlefish, giant centipedes, and assassin bugs are all dressed to kill.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南方的絨毛蛛猴朵拉邁出了離開媽媽咪咪的第一步,跟著牠一起領略巴西大西洋沿岸森林的魅力吧.學習蛛猴群的動作技巧,學習掛尾技術,並看看這個小傢伙在同齡人中找到自己的位置.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the enchantment of Brazils Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一旦天氣變冷變黑,昆蟲開始從草地和田地消失,牠們會慢慢消失直至全滅.所有動物都有其特殊的生存方式,像燕子和鶴這種候鳥會飛向南方,許多像鹿一樣的哺乳動物會得到厚厚的冬季皮毛或躲在溫暖的地方冬眠.但昆蟲都做了甚麼?為何牠們在春天就會回歸?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cr...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在殘酷的動物王國中,狡猾和蠻力決定了生存的一方.有些動物擁有強大的化武來增加生存機會.不同的化學物質有不同的用途:一些毒液能癱瘓獵物,而另一些則將捕食者內部變成容易消化的糊狀物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine the lives of creatures with really strange skills. From poison-shooting arachnids to ink-bombing octopuses to bifocal-eyed beetles, these animals use their powers to help them defeat predators and ensure their survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年頭幾個月裡,地軸的傾斜為某些地方帶來夏天,某些地方則是冬天.瞭解生物如何在這些極端條件下生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early months of the year, the Earths axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從遍及日本的櫻花浪潮到最終到達大堡礁產卵的綠海龜群,環遊世界去見證三月發生的大氣變化,
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與勇敢的浣熊小貓蒂亞戈一起踏上冒險之旅.看看這個像浣熊一樣的小傢伙如何磨練自己的嗅覺與覓食技能,穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的巴西森林家園附近的郊區公路,同時躲避被汽車撞到的危險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太恐怖了!這是謀殺!殘酷的死亡以及刺激的戰鬥,還有特殊的絕地救援.你在看到它之後就會知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其實就是你附近的草叢.利用來自恐怖類型的型格設備,這部非凡的自然紀錄片將帶您跟隨一位著名英雄,牠有六條腿,紅色的翅膀和七個黑點,這趟旅程的目的地是一個看似正常但充滿怪物的草叢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇怪的生物「海洋怪球」是關於生活在海底的一些奇異和驚人的動物.生活在競爭激烈的環境中,代表著他們的進化之路歷盡奇怪的曲折,從擁有比子彈更快的前肢,到能夠隱藏在沙下伏擊毫無防備的獵物.這些動物以其令人印象深刻的適應力脫穎而出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into the lives of the oceans weirdest animals. Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fishs eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度,狡猾和敏捷?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西美麗的潘塔納爾濕地,參觀巨型水獺的最後一個棲息地.跟隨幼崽里奧和牠的兄弟姐妹,看他們如何試水,如何聯手躲避美洲虎的伏擊,並成為一個有凝聚力的家庭單位,共同狩獵並繁衍生息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazils beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 保護區的猩猩六年級了,他們將面臨放歸野外的考驗,和他們一起體驗這個歷程中的情緒過山車和成長痛苦.探索迪拉的命運是如何突然改變的,並觀看大男孩貝尼如何應對令人討厭的節食計劃.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuarys orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dillas fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 甲蟲已經在地球上居住了超過2.4億年.科學家們已知的甲蟲大約有38萬種,而每年都會發現數百種新品種.世上四分之一的動物是甲蟲.牠們幾乎征服了地球上每個角落和棲息地,在每次全球災難中都能倖存下來.牠們為何如此成功?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the worlds animals are beetles. They have conquer...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是自然界中最具戲劇性的事件之一. 捕食者殺戮獵物時,血肉橫飛,塵土飛揚,爪子和牙齒都染紅.不過大自然的殺戮機器是如何實現這種史詩式的速度,狡猾和敏捷?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在野外狩獵,躲避掠食者和交配不僅需要技能,還需要完美地適應身體各部分.在某些情況下,進化會把身體部位變成真正厲害的工具.在本集中,我們會遇到一些動物:擬態章魚,墨西哥鈍口螈,三種鳥類和指猴,牠們的身體部位使它們在生存戰中佔據優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解世上最大的火山島,一個孤獨而崎嶇不平的地方,蒸汽散逸,水花四濺,每天都有新土地誕生.且看冰火交融如何打造地球上最強大的地質島嶼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn about the worlds largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽從前由冰雕鑿而成,現在則是由火山建構的島嶼.大約150萬年前,一塊冰地從北而下並覆蓋了整片土地.時至今日,巨大的冰川仍繼續一邊雕刻著海洋懸崖,一邊砍伐山脈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走進芬迪灣洶湧的水域.瞭解這個東岸生態系統如何維持眾多生物,當中包括成千上萬的海鳥,世上最快的捕食者,以及複雜的無脊椎動物網絡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the Bay of Fundys surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the worlds fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大不列顛島的西海岸,世上最長的無間斷步道穿越超過800英里的壯麗景色.威爾斯海岸的多樣化景觀簡直是地質瑰寶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the worlds longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟.它被大西洋,莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giants Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌.從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canadas only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與美洲虎幼崽弗里達一起探索極限,她正在巴西的凱門保護區磨練自己的生存技能.學習如何與媽媽加圖納一起潛行,看姐姐阿努克幫助她躲避飢餓的入侵者,最後進行一次冒險但幸運的單獨跋涉,.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看海獅蘿拉在阿根廷海岸的雄性戰場上邁出的第一步.觀察這個海獅寶寶學會了關鍵的發聲和游泳技能,努力留在媽媽瑪麗亞身邊並以迅雷不及掩耳之勢躲過致命捕獵,為她歡呼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南方的絨毛蛛猴朵拉邁出了離開媽媽咪咪的第一步,跟著牠一起領略巴西大西洋沿岸森林的魅力吧.學習蛛猴群的動作技巧,學習掛尾技術,並看看這個小傢伙在同齡人中找到自己的位置.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the enchantment of Brazils Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與勇敢的浣熊小貓蒂亞戈一起踏上冒險之旅.看看這個像浣熊一樣的小傢伙如何磨練自己的嗅覺與覓食技能,穿過鬱鬱蔥蔥的巴西森林家園附近的郊區公路,同時躲避被汽車撞到的危險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴西美麗的潘塔納爾濕地,參觀巨型水獺的最後一個棲息地.跟隨幼崽里奧和牠的兄弟姐妹,看他們如何試水,如何聯手躲避美洲虎的伏擊,並成為一個有凝聚力的家庭單位,共同狩獵並繁衍生息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazils beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 調查非洲驚人動物們那多采多姿,怪誕的生存策略.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看一些動物如何從出生就被注入「怪異」基因,並觀賞園丁鳥為吸引配偶而呈獻的奇特舞蹈動作.到聖誕島見證螃蟹使出躲避交通的當家本領,以及紅鮭驚人的逆流游泳技能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜會自然界中最受關注的物種,暸解為何最壞的伙伴並未得到應有的尊重.看看大白鯊的電力感應器,枯葉螳螂的鋒利肢體,以及蟲草菌煉成「殭屍」的能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探確保物種在野外互利共生的奇特聯盟.探索小丑魚和海葵之間的夥伴關係,觀察牛椋鳥如何保持草原居民的健康,並揭開糞金龜和豬籠草之間的互利關係.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需.觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量.追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集會看一些世上最大的昆蟲.蟬形齒指蝦蛄被獵食者威嚇時,會打開翅膀,展露代表警告的色彩和圖案.巨型非洲百足是溫和的草食性動物,但不代表能欺負牠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crawl along with some of the worlds fiercest insects. Watch as giant cockroaches build their immune systems to ensure long life. Then check out the toxic prowess of giant millipedes and the invisibility cloaks of giant prickly stick insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視野對生存尤關重要.這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法.眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vision – its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼.捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會.當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化.20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道.這是牠們堅守的土地.世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少.然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴.這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功.從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人.牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身.某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的.從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中.物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, ever...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔.遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛.觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程.穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無間的生死大戰中,動物已經進化出各種各樣的顏色,圖案和形狀,幫助它們捕獵,隱藏和保護自己.我們在本集解釋了一些最有趣的偽裝和變色能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hiding in plain sight helps many insect, fish, and amphibian species survive. Learn the ins and outs of an array of animal invisibility techniques, such as warning and disruptive colouration, mimicry, and active camouflage.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾暸解一些賦予動物生存優勢的超強能力.目睹螢火蟲迷人的閃光,眼鏡猴驚人的夜視能力;見證螳螂蝦的致命一擊,以及了解幫助鹹水鱷檢測獵物的壓力感應器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略.參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲.發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這片小林地中,兩隻幼猴面臨一生中最艱難的日子.牠們要在世上找到一席之地時,必須瞭解哪些鄰居是盟友,哪些是敵人;誰值得信賴,誰應該避開.牠們會失去或得到朋友,這樣才算是林地的一份子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this small patch of woodland, two young monkeys face the toughest time of their lives. As they find their place in the world, they must learn which neighbors are allies, and which are foes. Who to trust, and who to avoid. They will suffer loss,...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 尼羅鱷和河馬是非洲兩種淡水兩棲類的表表者,在整個非洲大陸的水道,河流和湖泊中都有其蹤影,亦包括南非夸祖魯納塔爾省的壯麗荒野.這兩個物種共存數千年,以不同的方式進化成依水而生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africas amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed ...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson joins the US Marines Heavy Haulers squadron as theyre put to the test. They battle to keep their fleet of CH53 Super Stallion choppers flying, in preparation for intense warfare training exercises in the desert and mountains.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入世上最極端,最容易發生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鳥的團隊.他們使用鏟子,壓雪車,甚至二戰的榴彈砲,奮力保衛陡峭斜坡的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson embeds with the team of one of the most extreme, avalanche-prone mountain ski mountains in the world - Snowbird. They battle to keep the steep and deep slopes safe with shovels, snowcats and even a WWII Howitzer cannon.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣加入正準備接受試驗的美國海軍陸戰隊的重型運輸機中隊.他們致力保持CH53超級種馬直升機機隊飛行,為在沙漠和山區進行激戰的訓練演習作準備.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣展開一場跨國公路旅行,以幫助井井有條基金會.他們致力尋找並封鎖全美各地估計200萬個洩漏,有毒,可能致命的廢棄石油和天然氣井.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes on a cross-country road trip to help the Well Done Foundation. They work to find and cap some of the estimated two million leaking, toxic - potentially deadly abandoned oil and gas wells that are scattered throughout the U.S.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.programme_title_tc: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #4
epg.programme_title_en: Alan Cummings Most Luxurious Train Journeys: Scotland #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這城市擁有悠久的歷史和大量的美食,還有令人驚喜的高水準明火烹飪,新鮮義大利小雲吞和意想不到經典費城牛肉芝士三文治.文拿與喜劇演員馬士祖班尼一起學習製作美味的冬甩,並吃下一個極巨大的肉丸三文治.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The city rich in history and hearty food surprises with elevated live-fire cooking, fresh Capalachi pasta and an unexpected turn on the classic Philly Cheesesteak. Mena learns to make delectable donuts with funnyman Maz Jobrani and crushes an absol

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿到訪一個充滿傳統⋯⋯和肉汁的城市,他品嚐了豐盛的素魁北克經典美食-蓋澆薯條,煙燻肉三文治,加拿大肉餡餅和著名的蒙特婁貝果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena visits a city steeped in tradition... and gravy, as he indulges in hearty planted-based Quebecois classics-poutine, smoked meat sandwiches, tourtiere, and the famous Montreal bagel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想徵戰澳門格蘭披治大賽.她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手.她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amateur driver Vivian Siu chases her dream of racing the Macau Grand Prix. Self-funded and with minimal experience, she quickly jumps to Formula 4, becoming the first female driver in the Chinese Championship. She faces the huge challenge of driving

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門大賽從賽程中移除,Vivian 的賽車之旅遭遇挫折,夢想面臨終結.即使有一絲希望,她仍需在數週內完成尋找賽車,車隊和搭檔車手的艱鉅任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vivians journey hits a roadblock when the Macau Grand Prix is removed from the calendar, threatening to end her dream. Even with a small chance of hope, she faces the immense task of securing a car, a team, and a co-driver in mere weeks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險,叢林健行,極致享受的巧克力按摩,蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland, Bonnie teams up with the twins for an epic escape-whale watching, volcano trekking, horseback riding, and inspiring eco chats under the midnight sun.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chronicling ABBAs rise from Eurovision to global stardom, their iconic sound, record-breaking success, solo endeavors, ABBA Gold revival, and cutting-edge hologram tour Voyage that reunited the virtual band.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到好萊塢的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展,個人生活,心理健康,慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季.這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞臺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer has arrived in Alaska.This sets the scene for one of the worlds greatest migrations of the Alaskan salmon run.

epg.programme_title_en: Alaska: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵.不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humpback whales return to Alaskas rich feeding grounds and salmon return to spawn in the rivers. The returning salmon however have to negotiate a path past hungry brown bears.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠交談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to talk to each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examining nature’s most sociable animals, unveiling the surprising and incredible behaviours that have evolved in response to cohabitation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場前所未見的流星雨,讓一名科學家,他的助手以及一名陰謀論者察覺到一個巨大的掩蓋行動,以及一場更龐大的威脅--一顆正朝地球逼近,足以毀滅世界的隕石.他們必須爭分奪秒揭露真相,拯救地球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores top-notch breads and pastries from Taiwan. She talks with award-winning bakers and learns what makes their creations worth the recognition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《萊恩雷諾斯:談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到好萊塢的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展,個人生活,心理健康,慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ryan Reynolds: Funny Business is a documentary tracing the actors rise from Vancouver to Hollywood, exploring his comedic evolution, personal life, mental health, philanthropy, and social media mastery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日.但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具. 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Barbie celebrates her 65th birthday in 2024. But she is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic and way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a children’s sensation.

epg.programme_title_tc: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
epg.programme_title_en: Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性,有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格:為行動而生
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一.他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings in Thal to becoming one of the biggest names in Hollywood. He began as a bodybuilder, he turned to acting and politics, this is the life and many trials of the legendary action star, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色.他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽.而我們都知道他......是 湯姆漢克斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as America’s Nice Guy, The Everyman and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him... as Tom Hanks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: From Broadway to blockbuster, Hugh Jackman is one of the most versatile performers of his generation. This documentary traces his journey from humble Australian beginnings to global stardom as Wolverine. Through stage triumphs and personal challenges

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Step back in time! Explore Queensland’s ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, it’s a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看50年代的廣告活動如何推出新的美國傳統和明天會更好的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how ad campaigns from the 50s launched new American traditions and the promise of a bright tomorrow.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 審視60年代的廣告男女,以及他們如何用智慧和嘲諷來接觸新受眾,因而改革整個產業.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine 60s ad men and women and how they used wit and irony to reach a new audience, consequently revolutionizing the industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alan’s rare journey sails to Iona and Staffa, tours Scone Palace and VA Dundee, reunites with a Broadway friend, savours Oban seafood, and ends with a ceilidh and farewell over the Forth Bridge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這城市擁有悠久的歷史和大量的美食,還有令人驚喜的高水準明火烹飪,新鮮義大利小雲吞和意想不到經典費城牛肉芝士三文治.文拿與喜劇演員馬士祖班尼一起學習製作美味的冬甩,並吃下一個極巨大的肉丸三文治.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The city rich in history and hearty food surprises with elevated live-fire cooking, fresh Capalachi pasta and an unexpected turn on the classic Philly Cheesesteak. Mena learns to make delectable donuts with funnyman Maz Jobrani and crushes an absol

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿到訪一個充滿傳統⋯⋯和肉汁的城市,他品嚐了豐盛的素魁北克經典美食-蓋澆薯條,煙燻肉三文治,加拿大肉餡餅和著名的蒙特婁貝果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena visits a city steeped in tradition... and gravy, as he indulges in hearty planted-based Quebecois classics-poutine, smoked meat sandwiches, tourtiere, and the famous Montreal bagel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果.他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果.
